facts.text: Each completed-task answer becomes its own `kind: fact` record with source `taskmanage-answer:<session>:<task>:<question>`; its status is `verified` only when `anchored.verified` is true, otherwise `candidate`, and unresolved refs are appended to the record text.

`node tools/e2e/taskmanage-answer-memory.mjs` runs real Pi with TaskManage and task-candidate-capture against a scripted loopback provider, checking that evidence-anchored answers are recalled via `recallKnowledge`, go stale when a cited span changes, and that path-only evidence stays candidate.

AGENTS.md documents the per-answer records, anchor types, the verified rule, frozen anchors, the read-time stale check, the meaning of 'verified' (evidence unchanged, not answer correct), and the e2e command.

The memory store is keyed by the git worktree toplevel (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`), so subdirectories of one worktree share a store and other worktrees use a different store; span paths are stored relative to that root.
